issue.sop_title: Disk Error Diagnosis and Repair via Chkdsk

steps.description: Perform a rapid, non-intrusive read-only scan of the target drive to identify logical structural faults or integrity anomalies.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect output for phrases like 'corrupt', 'bad sectors', 'integrity anomalies', or 'errors found'. If any are present, set variable 'disk_anomalies_detected' to 'true'.

steps.description: Schedule a deep file system and sector repair scan if anomalies were detected in Step 1. This will correct errors and recover unreadable data from degraded blocks.
steps.danger_warning: This step will schedule a volume lock and force a system reboot. Ensure user authorization for operational downtime (30 minutes to 2+ hours).
steps.output_parse_instruction: No output parsing required. This step prepares the system for a reboot.

steps.description: Force an immediate system reboot to initialize the repair scan scheduled in Step 2.
steps.danger_warning: This step will immediately reboot the system. Ensure all user data is saved and no critical processes are running.
